name: chart-map-01
title: Population map
description: A world population choropleth with country details and theme-aware teal colors.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive population choropleth in an understated editorial card. Use a large world map on a clean theme-aware background, a small Population / 2024 eyebrow, the title “A world of people”, and a brief explanation. Shade countries using seven ordered teal bands, from under one million to one billion or more, with a separate neutral no-data color. Use distinct Tailwind light and dark palettes and fine contrasting borders. Hovering, focusing, or tapping a country reveals its name and formatted population in a stable detail panel above the map. Provide a labeled country select so small countries are accessible. Show a wrapping color legend below the map, World Bank population attribution and Natural Earth boundary attribution. Keep the map responsive without horizontal overflow, provide accessible country names and population values, and visible keyboard focus. Use a fixed 2024 snapshot; omit playback and timeline controls. Missing values must be explicitly labeled “No data”.

Use TanStack Charts geographic geometry with an Equal Earth projection and bundled GeoJSON boundaries. Exclude Antarctica. Fit the complete map into a responsive 2:1 viewport. Each country supports pointer hover, click or tap selection, and keyboard focus; Enter and Space select the focused country.
